name: Ramssol Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，Ramssol Group Berhad 通过其间接全资子公司 Rams Fintech Sdn Bhd 完成收购 INNIO Holding Sdn Bhd 60% 股权及 Agensi Pekerjaan INNIO Sdn Bhd 49% 股权，将业务扩展至外劳管理及相关服务领域。此外，公司完成多项股票发行及融资活动，包括为收购发行 15,428,000 股代价股份。其他业务线在公告中未见具体动态。
overview_en: In 2026, Ramssol Group Berhad, through its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Rams Fintech Sdn Bhd, completed the acquisitions of a 60% equity interest in INNIO Holding Sdn Bhd and a 49% equity interest in Agensi Pekerjaan INNIO Sdn Bhd, expanding into foreign worker management and related services. The company also completed several share issuance and fund-raising exercises, including the issuance of 15,428,000 consideration shares for the acquisitions.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 集团层面完成对 INNIO 相关公司的收购，并完成代价股份发行。
segments.note_en: At the group level, the acquisitions of the INNIO-related companies were completed and the consideration shares were issued.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 15,428,000 股代价股份于 2026 年 7 月 24 日在 ACE Market 完成上市及报价。
actions.text_en: The listing and quotation of 15,428,000 consideration shares on the ACE Market were completed on 24 July 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 收购事项于 2026 年 7 月 20 日完成。
actions.text_en: The acquisitions were completed on 20 July 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 股份买卖协议的所有先决条件已获满足，协议于 2026 年 7 月 13 日成为无条件。
actions.text_en: All conditions precedent under the share sale agreements were fulfilled, and the agreements became unconditional on 13 July 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 双方同意将股份买卖协议的截止日期延长至 2026 年 7 月 31 日。
actions.text_en: The parties mutually agreed to extend the cut-off date of the share sale agreements to 31 July 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Bursa Securities 批准 15,428,000 股代价股份的上市及报价。
actions.text_en: Bursa Securities approved the listing and quotation of 15,428,000 consideration shares.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 就收购事项向 Bursa Securities 提交 15,428,000 股代价股份的额外上市申请。
actions.text_en: Submitted an additional listing application to Bursa Securities for 15,428,000 consideration shares in relation to the acquisitions.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过收购 INNIO Holding Sdn Bhd 60% 股权及 Agensi Pekerjaan INNIO Sdn Bhd 49% 股权，集团将业务扩展至外劳管理及相关服务领域。
model_changes.text_en: Through the acquisitions of a 60% equity interest in INNIO Holding Sdn Bhd and a 49% equity interest in Agensi Pekerjaan INNIO Sdn Bhd, the group expanded into foreign worker management and related services.
